description: Investigator OPSEC — threat-model who might notice you, control your attribution surface across IP, ASN, browser and TLS fingerprint, timing and logged-in accounts, separate research identity from real identity, build and age a sockpuppet research persona, and choose between VPN, residential proxy and Tor. Use when setting up a research account, avoiding tipping off a subject, worrying about LinkedIn profile-view leakage, needing a burner phone or email, or hardening a research VM or browser profile. Applies to covert due diligence, insider-threat investigation, source protection in journalism, and law-enforcement online work. Reference at useosint.com/skills/investigate-without-getting-made.
